## Activity

During January 2023, Market Eye Clinic completed 369 photographic captures. This provides the activity record for the month and indicates the volume of imaging submitted for review. The service continued to process captures through the usual site workflow, with activity recorded against the clinic rather than reported separately by staff member or session.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed, 21 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 5.7 per cent. These images could not be used for a definitive grading outcome and are reported separately from images that proceeded to grading. The result should be considered alongside the overall capture activity for January 2023.

## Grading

A total of 75 results were graded as referable. The median grading lag was 2 days, providing the central measure of the time between capture and completion of grading. This measure is reported with the referable result count to support routine monitoring of service timeliness.

Staff raised no new equipment faults during January 2023. Overall, the report records the clinic’s activity, image quality, referable grading outcomes and grading timeliness for the month.
